{{Otheruses|Belt}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:AlderaanRoyaltyBelt.png|thumb|right|250px|Leia and her belt]]
A '''symbolic belt''' was worn by the [[Gender/Legends|women]] of the royal class of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. It was normally worn with the [[Alderaan royal family traditional gown]], such as the one that [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] wore.<ref name="SWTVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The princess wore the belt during the events surrounding the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="SW4">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and on board the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="SW5">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Leias_belt-Star_Wars_Costumes.jpg|250px|thumb|Close up of the prop belt]]
This belt first seen in {{Film|IV}} and briefly at the end of {{Film|V}} was created by prop builder [[Arnold Jackson]] for ''A New Hope'', assisting costume designer [[John Mollo]].<ref name="Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref>

The original belt was made of white leather detailed with aluminum pieces. A second similar belt was created for the final award ceremony scene.<ref name="Costumes" />
